wiki_acceptance: Painting a grow zone on dirt -> crops appear and grow there.
summary: Added the missing player-facing GROW-ZONE DESIGNATION + auto-plant layer for farming, mirroring the just-shipped MineDesignation.cs / DeconstructDesignation.cs EXACTLY. The crop MECHANIC already existed end-to-end (CropEntity grows via growthPerSecond -> ripens IsRipe -> is right-click harvestable for food; the starter settlement spawns CropEntity on dirt). Previously there was NO way for the player to designate where crops grow. This wave adds the the reference sim-correct 'paint a grow zone on dirt, idle pawns plant crops there' flow. ZERO SceneSetup hot-file budget spent (toggle button self-attaches to the existing Canvas; the per-cell zone marker is a runtime code-built tinted 1x1 sprite). NO new pathfinding introduced (plant dispatch reuses PawnMovement.TryReserveWorkStandPos + the existing movement/path + a Time.unscaledTime give-up). CropEntity.cs was NOT touched (a freshly AddComponent'd CropEntity starts at growth 0 via its [SerializeField] default, so NO Spawn/SetGrowth(0) accessor was genuinely missing; the crop sprite is copied READ-ONLY off an existing scene CropEntity). PawnMiner/PawnBuilder/PawnUtilityAI/PawnContext/PawnActions UNTOUCHED (no dedicated grower pawn exists, so the manager owns the whole reserve->walk->plant cycle for an idle PawnEntity directly, exactly as MineDesignation dispatches to a PawnMiner but without editing AI files).

The new crop's sprite + sortingOrder are copied READ-ONLY off an existing scene CropEntity's SpriteRenderer; if none exists CropEntity falls back to its own color-tint path and still grows + is harvestable.)

design.manager_discipline: Mirrors MineDesignation.cs / DeconstructDesignation.cs EXACTLY: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] spawns one hidden DontDestroyOnLoad GO; FindFirstObjectByType idempotency guard; READ-ONLY poll-find of BuildManager / DeconstructDesignation / MineDesignation / Canvas / PawnEntities each frame (no OnEnable singleton capture - bug-pattern #7 firewall); timing via Time.unscaledTime deltas in Update, NOT a WaitForSeconds heartbeat (bug-pattern #9 firewall - no new always-on background timer).
design.hotkey: P (Plant) — a FREE key. Avoids every taken key per the lane contract: B/F/G/T/Y (build), N/R, X (deconstruct), M (mine).
design.mode: Grow mode toggled via self-built '경작 (P)' Canvas button + P hotkey. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with BuildManager build mode AND DeconstructDesignation deconstruct mode AND MineDesignation mine mode (entering grow cancels the other three via their existing read-only SetMode APIs; if any of the other three becomes active, grow leaves) so one left-click never fires two designation handlers. Right-click / ESC cancels.
design.designate: In mode, a left-press-then-drag sweeps a world-space rectangle of cells (MarkRect); a press-release-without-drag (< dragThreshold world units) is a single-cell click (MarkCell) — identical to MineDesignation. Each cell is validated by IsPlantableCell: REJECT impassable terrain (water/rock) via the EXACT PawnMovement.IsBlockedAt raw-tilemap guard BuildManager.TerrainBlocked reuses; REJECT non-walkable PathGrid cells; REJECT cells occupied by a structure/blueprint/vein/existing-crop. Accepted DIRT/soil cells get a subtle sprout-green tinted 1x1 quad zone marker (sortingOrder 2, below crops(3)/pawns) + a per-cell record (idempotent — re-mark is silent). SimulateClick / SimulateDragRect / DesignateCell expose pointer-free QA entry points.
design.dispatch: Throttled (0.5s) read-only poll: for each designated cell not already claimed by an in-flight plant job and not cell-reserved by another worker, find the nearest IDLE PawnEntity (PawnIdle mirrors PawnUtilityAI's pre-Decide gates: every worker component HasTask==false, !IsMoving, not drafted/manual/sleeping/breaking) and start a plant job — exactly how MineDesignation finds an idle miner, but assigned by the manager to avoid editing the utility-AI files (out of lane).
design.plant_cycle: REUSES the existing PawnMovement pathing WHOLESALE — NO new pathfinding. StartPlantJob reserves an adjacent walkable stand cell next to the target via PawnMovement.TryReserveWorkStandPos (same call PawnMiner/PawnBuilder use), reserves the planting cell via ReservationManager.TryReserveCell, and movement.SetTarget(stand). UpdatePlantJobs advances each job: when the pawn reaches its reserved stand cell (AtStandCell) or is within plantRange, it plants the crop and ends the job. A stalled walk (LastPathFailed / not moving past plantGiveUpSec) is abandoned via a Time.unscaledTime budget (WorkGiveUp spirit; NOT a WaitForSeconds coroutine — firewall #9). All reserved cells are released on job end.
design.plant_spawn: PlantCropAt builds a fresh GameObject + SpriteRenderer + CropEntity at the cell center, exactly matching the starter-settlement crop-spawn shape but at RUNTIME (the editor SceneSetup path uses AssetDatabase, unavailable at runtime — so the crop sprite is borrowed READ-ONLY off an existing scene CropEntity's SpriteRenderer; sortingOrder 3 like the starter farm). CropEntity.Awake adds its own collider and growth starts at 0, so the crop sprouts and grows on its own. The designated cell now holds a crop -> PruneZone drops its marker next tick.

qa_flags: SCENE-WIRING (button): the '경작 (P)' grow-mode toggle button is created at RUNTIME on the first Canvas found (anchored bottom-center, x-offset +462 — further right of the Mine button at +360 and Deconstruct at -360 — y inset 104 above the bar). NOT wired in any SceneSetup file. QA: confirm the button appears, click toggles grow mode (active highlight), the P hotkey toggles it, and it is mutually exclusive with the build ghost, the deconstruct '해체' mode, and the mine '채광' mode (entering one cancels the others; one left-click fires one handler).

SCENE-WIRING (zone marker): the per-cell grow-zone marker is a code-generated subtle sprout-green tinted 1x1 quad sprite (shared 1x1 white texture, sortingOrder 2 — below crops(3)/pawns, above ground) parented to the manager — no imported PNG / no prefab / no SceneSetup ref. QA: confirm a green tint shows on each designated dirt cell and disappears once a crop is planted there.

SCENE-WIRING (plant spawn): planted crops are runtime-built GameObjects (SpriteRenderer + CropEntity) whose sprite is copied READ-ONLY off an existing scene CropEntity; no prefab / no SceneSetup ref. QA: confirm a CropEntity appears on a designated cell after a pawn arrives and that it grows (growth rises -> ripens -> right-click harvestable).

VERIFY #17 end-to-end: enter grow mode, drag a rectangle (or click) over dirt/soil cells -> a green zone tint appears on each plantable cell (water/rock/occupied/existing-crop cells are REJECTED, no tint); an idle colonist walks to a designated empty cell and a CropEntity appears + begins to grow. Wiki #17 acceptance: 'Painting a grow zone on dirt -> crops appear and grow there.'

DIRT VALIDATION NOTE: there is no static DirtTile/GrassTile ref (only WaterTile/RockTile are statically tracked). IsPlantableCell therefore accepts any non-water/non-rock, walkable, unoccupied ground as soil — the same positive philosophy the starter settlement uses (it plants on plain dirt). If the operator wants grow zones restricted to a SPECIFIC dirt/grass tile only (the reference sim-strict soil-fertility gating), that is a tiny follow-up needing a static DirtTile ref wired in TilemapStaticRefInit (out of lane A this wave) — FLAGGED, not done.
NO HOT-FILE EDIT this wave: the lane's single SceneSetup hot-file budget was NOT spent (Mine/Deconstruct self-attach pattern reused).

CropEntity.cs UNTOUCHED: no Spawn/SetGrowth(0) accessor was added because none was genuinely missing — the [SerializeField] private float growth defaults to 0f, so a fresh CropEntity already starts at growth 0. (Reported per the lane instruction to add+note only if genuinely missing.)
